stations.title: Station 4: Audio & Voice Controls (Speech Calculator)
stations.desc: An invisible tool that uses Google's engine to convert the user's voice speech into written text that can be processed programmatically.
stations.story:
👋 Welcome, future coding hero!

Let's dive into our interactive session for Audio & Voice Controls (Speech Calculator)!

🎯 Key Points Covered in this Session:
  • 🎙️ SpeechRecognizer: An invisible tool that uses Google's engine to convert the user's voice speech into written text that can be processed programmatically.
  • 🗣️ Convert text to speech (TextToSpeech): A tool that pronounces written texts with clear and excellent human voices to speak to the user automatically.

💻 Starter Code Block - Convert text to speech (TextToSpeech):

when SpeechRecognizer1.AfterGettingText (result)
do set Label_Result.Text to get result
call TextToSpeech1.Speak (join "I said: " get result)

stations.title: Station 7: Edge Collisions & Bounce Physics (Pong Ball Game)
stations.desc: A movable spherical element placed inside the Canvas that has the properties of an automatic and physical bounce when it hits the edges and borders of screens.

stations.title: Station 9: Random Choice Logic (Rock Paper Scissors Game)
stations.desc: A tool for selecting a completely random item from a programming list, and it is widely used in programming artificial intelligence for competitive games.
stations.story:
👋 Welcome, future coding hero!

Let's dive into our interactive session for Random Choice Logic (Rock Paper Scissors Game)!

🎯 Key Points Covered in this Session:
  • 🎲 Random selection from lists: A tool for selecting a completely random item from a programming list, and it is widely used in programming artificial intelligence for competitive games.
  • 🏆 Programming comparison rules and calculating the winner: Use code terms to compare the user's choice with a random phone choice and determine the winner while adding an exciting sound.

💻 Starter Code Block - Programming comparison rules and calculating the winner:

set global pcChoice to call pick a random item (list = create empty list ["stone", "paper", "scissors"])
if (get global userChoice = get global pcChoice)
then set Label_Status.Text to "Tie!"
else if (get global userChoice = "stone" and get global pcChoice = "scissors")
then set Label_Status.Text to "You are the winner! 🎉"
